title: Entity Lineage
description: The `Lineage` for a given data asset, has information of the input datasets used and the ETL pipeline that created it.

dependencyType.description: Whether the upstream entity contributes values directly to the downstream entity or only influences it indirectly (e.g., via JOIN, WHERE/FILTER, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, QUALIFY, or WINDOW).

indirectColumn.description: An upstream column that influences the downstream dataset indirectly (e.g., via WHERE/FILTER, JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, QUALIFY, or WINDOW) without targeting a single output column.

fromColumn.description: Source column identified by fully qualified column name that indirectly influences the downstream entity.

transformationSubtype.description: Structured indirect transformation subtype (e.g., FILTER, JOIN, GROUP_BY, SORT, WINDOW, CONDITIONAL).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the indirect column dependency.

tempLineageTable.description: A single hop in a temporary table lineage path.

fromEntity.description: Source entity or table name for this hop.

toEntity.description: Target entity or table name for this hop.

fromColumns.description: One or more source columns identified by fully qualified column name used by transformation function to create destination column.

toColumn.description: Destination column identified by fully qualified column name created by the transformation of source columns.

function.description: Transformation function applied to source columns to create destination column. That is `function(fromColumns) -> toColumn`.

transformationSubtype.description: Structured transformation subtype (e.g., IDENTITY, TRANSFORMATION, AGGREGATION, FILTER, JOIN, GROUP_BY, SORT, WINDOW, CONDITIONAL).

lineageDetails.description: Lineage details including sqlQuery + pipeline + columnLineage.

columnsLineage.description: Lineage information of how upstream columns were combined to get downstream column.

pipeline.description: Pipeline where the sqlQuery is periodically run.

source.description: Lineage type describes how a lineage was created.

createdAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

assetEdges.description: Asset count in case of child assets lineage.

tempLineageTables.description: Lineage path through temporary/intermediate tables. Each element represents a hop with fromEntity and toEntity fields.

dependencyType.description: Whether this lineage edge represents a DIRECT data-flow dependency or an INDIRECT dependency. Unset/null is treated as DIRECT for backward compatibility.

indirectColumns.description: Dataset-level upstream columns that indirectly influence the downstream entity without targeting a single output column.

edge.description: Edge in the lineage graph from one entity to another by entity IDs.

fromEntity.description: From entity that is upstream of lineage edge.

toEntity.description: To entity that is downstream of lineage edge.

lineageDetails.description: Optional lineageDetails provided only for table to table lineage edge.

entitiesEdge.description: Edge in the lineage graph from one entity to another using entity references.

fromEntity.description: From entity that is upstream of lineage edge.

toEntity.description: To entity that is downstream of lineage edge.

lineageDetails.description: Optional lineageDetails provided only for table to table lineage edge.

entity.description: Primary entity for which this lineage graph is created.

nodes.descriptions: All the entities that are the nodes in the lineage graph excluding the primary entity.

upstreamEdges.descriptions: All the edges in the lineage graph that are upstream from the primary entity.

downstreamEdges.descriptions: All the edges in the lineage graph that are downstream from the primary entity.
